entities.summary: Santa María de Santa Cruz de la Serós is a former Benedictine nunnery in Spain. It is located about ten miles from Jaca, in the village of Santa Cruz de la Serós, which is named after the nunnery. The church of San Caprasio, built between 1020 and 1030, a half century earlier than Santa María, stands nearby in the same village. Santa María de Santa Cruz de la Serós is a Catholic church building in Europe, established in 1001. Relevant to cause-and-effect analysis.
